long_description: Keychain is an AI-powered consumer packaged goods (CPG) manufacturing platform based in New York, founded in 2023. The company focuses on helping brands and retailers efficiently connect with vetted manufacturing partners. Keychain's mission is to simplify CPG manufacturing by transforming product and manufacturing information into searchable data, enabling companies to move from product idea to production more quickly. The platform offers tools for discovering manufacturers, evaluating options, and managing various aspects of the manufacturing workflow, including sourcing, onboarding, and compliance. Keychain also features KeychainOS, an AI operating system designed for CPG manufacturing workflows. The company connects brands and retailers with a large network of North American manufacturers, claiming to serve over 20,000 clients, including eight of the top ten U.S. retailers and seven of the top ten CPG brands. Keychain has raised significant venture funding, with estimates ranging from $68 million to $78 million.
